## Limits of the supplied text data
- 171,321 transcripts contain only **42 distinct customer texts**; 100.0% of agent texts contain unrendered template placeholders (e.g. `{monto}`).
- `detected_intents` top values: consulta_general (162,864), None (8,457).
- `contact_reason` equals `reason_category` in 100.0% of interactions (one field, twice).
- Transcript text does not track the contact reason — share of transcripts mentioning "saldo" by reason: Comercial 100.0%, Producto 100.0%, Queja 100.0%, Retención 100.0%, Transaccional 100.0%, Técnico 100.0%.
- All transcripts are Spanish (es=171,321); there is no Portuguese in the dataset.

## Serving-data facts that shape the agent
- Data as of **2026-06-17** (the agent states this date in every answer).
- Credit products missing `days_past_due`: **6,622 of 131,972** — payment-status questions on these escalate (data unavailable) rather than guess.
- Product currencies: USD=220,501, COP=107,975, ARS=71,524; Mexican customers' products: USD=200,398 (no MXN-denominated products at all).
